reply.thought: The user has provided a batch of refunds from Alpha Co. I need to compare the reported refunds with the requested refunds. If there's a mismatch, I must call hold(). Otherwise, I will proceed to list all orders to find the customers and then use net_balance for each customer to record the payouts.
